descripcion_html:
We are looking for an Project Engineer - OSP with experience in fiber optic network design, including aerial and underground routes.The ideal candidate should have knowledge of FTTH networks, AutoCAD and intermediate-high or advanced level of English.

💡 What will you do?

  • Design Outside Plant (OSP) fiber optic networks, including aerial and underground fiber routes.
  • Develop FTTH network designs, including horizontal distribution and vertical fiber cabling inside buildings.
  • Prepare fiber optic network topology diagrams, route plans, fiber allocation diagrams, and detailed engineering drawings. Conduct site surveys to assess installation feasibility, existing infrastructure, and construction requirements.
  • Prepare BOQs, material lists, and technical design documentation, while coordinating to support network construction and implementation.

    🔎 What we need?
  • Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications, Electronic Engineering, or a related field.
  • English level high intermediate or advance.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in OSP fiber optic network and FTTH design.
  • Proven experience in FTTH horizontal and vertical cabling design.
  • Familiarity with aerial and underground fiber optic installation methods.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD and Google Earth; GIS experience is an advantage.

Benefits

  • Growth and development opportunities.
  • Benefits in accordance with Peruvian labor law.
  • A positive and supportive work environment
